items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: like Lionel with his xylophone and things

ctx.x: How about the music? When you and your brother came along, what did you play?

We played our instruments. We didn't have The Musical Meat Market because we give that up. It was too much for this little show to travel. We just had the regular instruments-- like Lionel with his xylophone and things. Then we'd walk over and play the chimes, you know, the big chimes, some of them this big, you know, and I think we played "Miserere" from "Il Trovatore" and things
